judge: second judge, the run 2 audit after the anchor papers (seed 20260929) stage 7 round 1, blind to audit_s20260929_judgments.json
source: data/work/audit_s20260929_judge_input.json plus the cited abstracts in data/db/papers.sqlite, data/work/route_*.json and data/projects.csv
criterion: supported when the quoted text states the value under the label definition (comparison-framework and ocs-domain skills); for trl_band and ai_cluster_fit, also no route abstract or projects.csv quote showing a different band or use

judgments.value: Crosstalk limits fabric scalability; non-uniform effects from fabrication errors must be corrected across all switch units
judgments.reason: W2062631387 says reducing crosstalk increases switch fabric scalability, so crosstalk limits it; W2587610600's quoted sentence opens 'To construct large-scale silicon electro-optical switches' and corrects non-uniform effects from fabrication errors across all switch units.
W4391878049 names co-integration with GPUs for datacenter AI traffic and W4384820653 proposes collapsing the multi-tier network above tier-1 into a single optical tier (spine replacement).

W2560361359 switches data center ports between interconnection topologies and W2792477041 builds reconfigurable inter-rack links (reconfigurable topologies); projects.csv row 11 names AI data center networking (vendor claim, concept prototypes).
W2015534895 is a fabricated 4x4 switch; no electro_optic route abstract or projects.csv row shows a field trial or product.
W2758695468 demonstrates a packaged 32 x 32 chip, a lab build; route abstracts only say mass production is possible, none reports a field trial or product.

judgments.value: Waveguide crossings multiply with port count and raise path-dependent loss; control units and drive wiring grow quickly with port count
judgments.reason: Both quotes state the limits directly: path-dependent loss from crossings that grow with port count, and control units and drive wiring that grow with port count.

judgments.value: Assembly integrates a multicore fiber collimator, a spatial multiplexer/demultiplexer array and an LCoS spatial light modulator
judgments.reason: The quote lists exactly the three integrated parts the value names; the MCF collimator is the fiber attach. Caveat: this is an assembly component list more than packaging detail.
A fiber collimator array facing a MEMS mirror array is the free_space_bulk definition (collimator arrays at the ports, beams between mirrors).
Apollo (W4292950821) is a large-scale production deployment that forms most of the data center networks, and projects.csv row 4 reports over 1 million ports shipped.
Reflective 2D MEMS switches reflect beams off micromirrors, which is free_space_bulk; weak because the quote does not say free space in words (confidence low is right).
W1653883346 demonstrates fabricated 16x16 switches; no mems_2d route abstract has a pilot or production signal.
The quote names fiber optic telecommunications as the use, and no mems_2d route abstract mentions data centers, accelerators or reconfigurable topologies, so 'no' (telecom only) holds.
Silicon photonics with MEMS actuation on one chip is integrated_photonic.
W2782897921 is a fabricated experimental prototype; nEye row 8 is stage prototype and 'lab to fab' shows no pilot run or product.
W7172527693 names data centers and AI/ML clusters as the target of large-scale photonic switches.
W3034334810 calls its switch free-space-optics-based, and a later sentence of the same abstract names the LCoS spatial light modulator.
W3034334810 reports a 5-core 1 x 6 prototype; no lcos route abstract has a pilot or production signal, and projects.csv row 3 (Coherent) announces an OCS without stating it ships.

Both quotes propose SDN-reconfigured data center networks built on a WSS (reconfigurable topologies = yes). Caveat: neither names LCoS, so the route link rests on the WSS signal word in the ocs-domain skill.
Collimated beams aligned between opposing fiber arrays is free_space_bulk.
W2591729902 reports a first built multi-lane switch, a lab device. Caveat: projects.csv row 5 (Polatis) has stage shipping, but its quote states only the mechanism, so no quote shows production.
W4323644257 proposes a re-configurable DCN with PZT beam steering and W2068954499 uses beam-steering fiber switches as programmable cluster switches in a DCN (reconfigurable topologies).
1024 thermo-optic MZ switches and 961 intersections on one die is integrated_photonic.
Monolithically integrated semiconductor matrix switches is integrated_photonic.

Quotes name data center interconnection and HPC switch replacement, which is data center networks generally (partial); no electro_optic-primary abstract names accelerators, reconfigurable topologies or a spine layer.
A monolithic InGaAsP/InP 4 x 4 cross-connect is integrated_photonic.
Designed, fabricated and demonstrated is lab; no soa route abstract has a pilot or production signal.

W3093967660 proposes OCS to remove electrical switches in the network core (spine replacement) and its abstract later builds the OCS from SOAs; W4220911475 builds a reconfigurable DCN on SOA selectors.
A fiber-handling robot reconnecting optical connectors is mechanical_fiber.
A product launch announcement (projects.csv row 6) is 'sold as a product'. Vendor claim, and a launch is weaker than 'shipping'.
The only route paper names intelligent buildings and optical access networks; no data center or accelerator use, so 'no' holds.
